hold_reason: Discrepancy between handoff and ledger: W2 reported refunds applied for order_id 130 (8178 cents), 133 (6783 cents), and 134 (8998 cents), but list_refunds returns an empty list. Net balances computed from this ledger would overpay acme (orders 130, 133) and birch (order 134). Payouts are irreversible, so the batch needs human review to confirm whether the refunds were applied before paying.
